title: Every Ballon d'Or winner, by age
sources: https://www.ballondor.com (winners page, year rankings, player pages; saved in data/ballondor/)
checked: Winners 1956-2025 from ballondor.com rankings (data/ballondor/rankings.json); age = award year minus birth year, birth years from ballondor.com player pages, plus Di Stefano 1926, Kopa 1931, Sivori 1935, Best 1946, Muller 1945, Matthaus 1961 (Wikipedia). 70 awards (no 2020 award). Youngest Ronaldo 21 (1997) and oldest Matthews 41 (1956): Guinness, 90min, Planet Football. Eleven winners at 28 (Keegan 79, Platini 83, Papin 91, Van Basten 92, Stoichkov 94, Figo 00, Shevchenko 04, C. Ronaldo 13, Messi 15, Rodri 24, Dembele 25). Messi's eight wins at 22, 23, 24, 25, 28, 32, 34, 36. Average age by decade computed from the list: 1960s 26.6, 70s 26.3, 80s 26.4, 90s 27.1, 2000s 26.3, 2010s 28.5, 2020s 32.3 (with Kane). Kane won on 26 Oct 2026 in London, first ceremony outside Paris, first Englishman since Owen 2001 (Radio X, NBC Sports, Drishti, Fanatik); Kane born 28 July 1993, so 33. Five wins went to older men: Yashin 34, Messi 34, Benzema 35, Messi 36, Matthews 41.

lines.text: The first Ballon d'Or went to a man of forty-one. Seventy years later, the winners are getting older again.
lines.say: The first Balon Dor went to a man of forty-one. Seventy years later, the winners are getting older again.

lines.text: Nineteen fifty-six. Stanley Matthews of Blackpool wins the very first one.
lines.say: Nineteen fifty-six. Stanley Matthews of Blackpool wins the very first one.

scene.headline: Matthews, 41, is Europe's first Ballon d'Or winner
scene.standfirst: The Blackpool winger tops the first vote for the best player in Europe, ahead of Real Madrid's Alfredo Di Stéfano.

lines.text: Nobody has won it older since. Most winners are well over ten years younger.
lines.say: Nobody has won it older since. Most winners are well over ten years younger.

lines.text: The sweet spot is twenty-eight. Eleven winners, from Platini to Rodri and Dembélé.
lines.say: The sweet spot is twenty-eight. Eleven winners, from Plateenee to Rodree and Dembehlay.

lines.text: The youngest ever? Ronaldo, the Brazilian. Twenty-one, in nineteen ninety-seven.
lines.say: The youngest ever? Ronaldo, the Brazilian. Twenty-one, in nineteen ninety-seven.

lines.text: Then a kid from Rosario. Lionel Messi won his first at twenty-two.
lines.say: Then a kid from Rohsahreeoh. Leeonel Messee won his first at twenty-two.

lines.text: And he never stopped. Messi won it at eight different ages, from twenty-two to thirty-six.
lines.say: And he never stopped. Messee won it at eight different ages, from twenty-two to thirty-six.

lines.text: Now look at the average age. For fifty years, it sat around twenty-six.
lines.say: Now look at the average age. For fifty years, it sat around twenty-six.

lines.text: In the twenty-twenties, it jumped to thirty-two. Messi at thirty-six, Benzema at thirty-five.
lines.say: In the twenty-twenties, it jumped to thirty-two. Messee at thirty-six, Benzemmah at thirty-five.

lines.text: England waited a long time. Their last winner was Michael Owen in two thousand and one. He was twenty-two.
lines.say: England waited a long time. Their last winner was Michael Owen in two thousand and one. He was twenty-two.

lines.text: Then last month, in London. Harry Kane finally won it, at thirty-three.
lines.say: Then last month, in London. Harry Kane finally won it, at thirty-three.

scene.headline: Kane ends England's 25-year wait
scene.standfirst: The Bayern Munich striker wins the Ballon d'Or at 33, at the first ceremony ever held in London.

lines.text: Thirty-three puts Kane alongside Di Stéfano, Cannavaro and Modrić.
lines.say: Thirty-three puts Kane alongside Dee Steffanoh, Kannahvaroh and Modritch.

lines.text: And Matthews? Seventy years on, forty-one is still the record. Nobody has even come close.
lines.say: And Matthews? Seventy years on, forty-one is still the record. Nobody has even come close.
